# Security Policy

**Moved.** The canonical, current security policy is [/SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) at the repo
root — GitHub prefers a root-level `SECURITY.md` for the repository's Security tab, so that's now
the single source of truth. This file is kept only so old links here don't 404; its content is not
maintained separately, to avoid the two drifting apart.

To report a vulnerability in the meantime: privately to
[@Srinivasan-78](https://github.com/Srinivasan-78) via a GitHub Security Advisory or email, not a
public issue.
